test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

The manager said that he would be on leave the next day.

options.text: The manager has said, “I will be on leave tomorrow”.
The manager said, “I would be on leave that day”.
The manager has said, “He will be on leave today”.
The manager said, “I will be on leave tomorrow”.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**The manager said, 'I will be on leave tomorrow'**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To convert a direct speech sentence into indirect speech, follow these rules:
 
• Identify the reporting verb and the reported speech.
 
 
• **Reporting verb**: said
 
• **Reported speech**: "he would be on leave the next day."
 
 
 
• Introduce the reported speech using an appropriate reporting verb, often based on the speaker's intention. In this case, "**said**" can be retained.
 
• "**he**" should change to "**I**" to reflect the reported speaker's perspective.
 
• Adjust the verb tense, if necessary, to reflect the shift from present (direct speech) to past (indirect speech).
 
• From indirect to direct "**would be"** will become **'will be**' as it represents the future tense in direct speech.
 
• "the next day" is changed to "**tomorrow**" for clarity and conciseness.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**
